idle.zh-CN: 安静地悬浮着，陪你待一会儿。

idle.en: The stars are quiet, and so am I.

needs-input.zh-CN: 轨道上有个问号在等你。
needs-input.en: A question mark is waiting in your orbit.
Could use a small hand here.

completed.en: That one glowed, just for you.

failed.en: The halo wobbled a little. It's okay.
Dim for a moment, then bright again.

milestone.en: The orbit widens; the light holds.

petting.en: The orb spins a happy half-turn.

welcome.en: You're back — the whole sector lit up.

ritual.zh-CN: 夜深了，光球调成了小夜灯模式。
ritual.en: Late night; the orb dimmed to night-light mode.
